constraints: If there is no data context set for the worksheet (via VP SET DATA CONTEXT), the command returns Null.
The returned type (Object or Collection) mirrors whatever type was set with VP SET DATA CONTEXT.

params.name: vpAreaName
params.description: 4D View Pro area form object name

params.name: sheet
params.description: Index of the sheet to get the data context from; current sheet if omitted

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the current data context (Object or Collection, or Null if none is set) of a worksheet, including any modifications made to its contents.
overloadMerges.note: Stage 1 doc scrape produced two byte-for-byte identical signature lines for this command (a scrape artifact, not a real overload); collapsed into a single overload.
